proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ H ι _ _ _ v
  rw [Submodule.topologicalClosure_eq_top_iff, Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    apply h x
    rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal]
    intro u hu
    induction hu using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem u hu => obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hu; exact hx i
    | zero => simp
    | add u w _ _ hu hw => rw [inner_add_left, hu, hw, add_zero]
    | smul c u _ hu => rw [inner_smul_left, hu, mul_zero]
  · intro h x hx
    exact h x fun i => (Submodule.mem_orthogonal _ _).mp hx (v i) (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (H ι : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 H] [CompleteSpace H] (v : ι → H), (Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range v)).topologicalClosure = ⊤ ↔ ∀ x, (∀ i, inner 𝕜 (v i) x = 0) → x = 0
